note: Prediction test: 8 domains x 4 age groups. Same option ids and weights in every age version; only wording changes. Weights: 0.5 = published study, 0.25 = hypothesis. Model: multinomial logit (McFadden 1974), strength k. See the Prediction test tab in the Master Plan. v2.1: every option has a Why Chain ladder (consequence and value, Reynolds & Gutman 1988; values from Schwartz). Weights and options unchanged, so results stay comparable with v2.
